settings.title: Conversion & Repair Options
settings.fmt_ply_desc: Polygon File for 3D Scanning & Point Cloud
settings.fmt_off_desc: Object File Format for Computational Geometry
settings.mode_client_tip: ⚡ 100% in-browser processing via WebAssembly/Web Workers. Models never leave your device. Zero cost & maximum privacy.
settings.mode_server_tip: ☁️ Connects to a 16GB RAM FreeCAD/OpenCASCADE node for proprietary SolidWorks, Inventor, and IFC CAD files.
settings.auto_engine_cad_prop_reason: Detected proprietary CAD/BIM format (.{{ext}}). Automatically routed to Cloud Server Node for precision B-Rep sewing.
settings.auto_engine_cad_std_server_reason: Detected industrial CAD format (.{{ext}}). Routed to Dedicated Cloud Node for high-precision tessellation.
settings.auto_engine_cad_std_client_reason: Detected CAD format (.{{ext}}). Configured Pure Client mode for instant in-browser processing.
settings.auto_engine_mesh_reason: Detected standard mesh (.{{ext}}). Pure Client mode applied: 100% local processing, zero privacy leak, instant results.
settings.preset_3dprint_desc: Recommended for 3D printing. Checks all repair options to guarantee a 100% watertight closed solid and prevent slicer errors.
settings.preset_game_desc: Recommended for game assets & rendering. Unifies normals and cleans degenerate faces without forcefully closing open conduits or artistic holes.
settings.preset_asis_desc: Unchecks all repair options. Preserves 100% original vertices and topology, purely converting the file format without modifications.
settings.auto_fill_holes_tip: When to use: Mandatory for 3D printing solid parts. Uncheck if your model is intentionally designed with open surfaces or pipes.
settings.fix_non_manifold_tip: When to use: When edges are shared by >2 faces or vertices self-intersect, causing slicer slicing errors.
settings.unify_normals_tip: When to use: When 3D rendering shows dark inverted shadows or flipped face orientations.
settings.remove_degenerate_tip: When to use: Removes zero-area needle triangles and duplicate overlapping faces to reduce file size and optimize rendering.
settings.privacy_guarantee: 100% Client-Side Offline: Models never leave your device. Zero privacy risk.

backend_modal.title: Dedicated Engine Node Setup
backend_modal.subtitle: Unlock SolidWorks, Inventor & IFC Native B-Rep Sewing & Heavy Model Translation
backend_modal.public_node_desc: Zero signup needed. Connect to the public shared cloud engine instantly for lightweight models.
backend_modal.hf_duplicate_desc: Duplicate the pre-configured FreeCAD/OpenCASCADE cloud engine directly into your own free Hugging Face account with total privacy.
backend_modal.fields_guide_title: Hugging Face Form Fields Guide (100% Free):
backend_modal.guide_owner: Owner (Account): Automatically populated with your Hugging Face account (Google login supported).
backend_modal.guide_hardware: Space hardware: Select CPU Basic (2 vCPU · 16 GB · Free) (100% free, optimized for CAD sewing).
backend_modal.table_row_scene_priv: Professional CAD engineering, large assemblies & strict privacy
backend_modal.table_row_privacy_priv: 100% Isolated private space (Only you have access)
backend_modal.input_url_label: Engine Node URL (Supports Space link or Direct URL)
backend_modal.client_desc: In this mode, all 3D mesh algorithms, defect repairs, topological checks, and format conversions (STL, OBJ, 3MF, PLY, GLTF/GLB) run strictly inside your browser via WebAssembly and Web Workers. Your 3D models never leave your computer, ensuring total privacy and $0 cost.
backend_modal.client_limitation: Note: Proprietary CAD formats (.sldprt, .sldasm, .ipt, .ifc) require a Python FreeCAD/OpenCASCADE server node for exact B-Rep tessellation.
backend_modal.hf_sleep_tip: (If using a free Hugging Face space, cold start wakeup takes ~30-45s, please re-test shortly)

cad_unlock.title: Native CAD Format Unlock
cad_unlock.desc_1: You uploaded a proprietary native CAD format (such as SolidWorks, Inventor, or IFC). These closed B-Rep formats require FreeCAD and OpenCASCADE to perform boundary representation sewing and exact surface tessellation.
cad_unlock.desc_2: You can choose either of the following solutions:
cad_unlock.opt0_desc: Connect directly to the official cloud node, automatically enabling FreeCAD/OpenCASCADE to translate this model.
cad_unlock.opt1_desc: Launch your own FreeCAD/OpenCASCADE node on Hugging Face Spaces (16GB RAM · Free) in 1 minute to unlock full cloud translation.
cad_unlock.opt2_title: Or export as STEP / STL / OBJ in your CAD software
cad_unlock.opt2_desc: Standard open formats (STEP, STL, OBJ, 3MF) support 100% pure client-side offline conversion in browser.
